question: 是否可以把八极关联严格限定在 beta2≈0.15–0.20，并用 beta2 单变量解释 beta3/PES 软化？
answer: 不能。该区间是部分 Ba、Sm/Gd 结果中常见的经验窗口，不是跨核素、跨EDF/RMF的普适上限或下限。

claims.claim: Gogny-D1M Sm/Gd二维PES在N=86,88附近沿beta3软，N=88可有浅非零极小；N>=90沿beta3变陡。
148Ba和150Ba的RMF最低点分别约(beta2,beta3)=(0.26,0.17)和(0.28,0.17)，位于预设0.15–0.20窗口上方。
Ba八极极小与N=88/N=94/Z=56附近能隙及nu f7/2-i13/2、pi d5/2-h11/2驱动对相关。
D1S/D1M给出146Sm的Q30=0而148,150Sm有有限八极极小；150Sm平均场能量增益约105–204 keV，表明软动态关联。
220–240U的四极最低点深且长椭，但222–230U仍出现非零Q3极小，深度不超过约1.5 MeV。
八极响应的控制项可分为Q3矩阵元、占据因子、准粒子分母、配对和残余相互作用；beta2不构成单变量单调判据。
小D0或B(E1)可由质子—中子偶极相消产生，不能单独反推小beta3或弱B(E3)。

schematic_response_formula: chi3(beta2) ~ 2 sum_{mu<nu} |Q3_munu(beta2)|^2 (u_mu v_nu + v_mu u_nu)^2 / (E_mu(beta2)+E_nu(beta2)); normalization and residual-interaction corrections are model dependent.
falsification_tests: Treat beta2=0.20 as universal upper bound: falsified by 148,150Ba RMF results.
Treat beta2>0.28 as automatic octupole quenching: contradicted by 222–230U nonzero Q3 minima in the cited actinide calculations.
Treat nonzero static beta3 as rigid pear shape: contradicted by soft 144Ba SCCM PES and shallow 150Sm mean-field gains.

model_comparison.Gogny_D1S_D1M: similar qualitative trends in cited Sm/Gd and actinide calculations; absolute minima, depths, spectra and transition strengths remain interaction dependent.
model_comparison.BCP1: actinide PECs can be similar, while pairing correlations and collective inertia differ substantially, including factors of two or more in some cases.
model_comparison.RMF_PK1: Ba calculation exposes large-beta2 octupole minima and identifies explicit near-Fermi gaps; it is a model-specific structural mechanism, not a universal number.
